intro: The Lorgalis Manuscript is an ancient text tied to the worship and lore of the Old Gods, preserved from the fallen night elven ruins beneath Ashenvale. Hidden within the sunken temple complex of Blackfathom Deeps, it holds secrets coveted by dark scholars seeking to awaken ancient, slumbering powers.

sections.t: A Tome of Those Who Sleep
p: Dating back to the grand elven temples that stood before the Great Sundering, the Lorgalis Manuscript survived the cataclysmic flooding that submerged the ruins of Blackfathom. While the elves of antiquity gathered deep secrets, parts of their archives recorded darker powers. The manuscript contains potent lore tied directly to the Old Gods—knowledge said to open mystical doorways and stir ancient entities that sleep deep beneath the world. Stored away in a pitted iron chest amidst the flooded corridors, it has drawn the attention of cultists and shadow scholars alike.
